description: Amid growing frustration with both US retrenchment and EU paralysis, a coalition of mid-tier European states—Poland, Sweden, Finland, and the Netherlands—begins informal coordination on joint AI procurement, shared red-teaming exercises, and mutual infrastructure protection. The pact emerges outside EU institutions but aligns with broader sovereignty goals, creating a de facto parallel structure. It gains momentum as trust in centralized EU action erodes and national-level preparedness becomes urgent.
